Website Sign In Search Government Elected Officials Departments Business Residents Home Government Boards & Commissions Board of Appeals Hearing - 12/02/2026 Hearing - 12/02/2026 NOTICE OF PUBLIC HEARING BY THE BOARD OF APPEALS Pursuant to New York State Town Law Article 16, New York State Public Officers Law Article 7, and the Town of Hempstead Building Zone Ordinance, NOTICE is hereby given that the BOARD OF APPEALS of the Town of Hempstead will hold a public hearing in the Town Meeting Pavilion, Town Hall Plaza, One Washington Street, Hempstead, New York on 12/02/2026 at 9:30 A.M. to consider the following applications and appeals: --- THE FOLLOWING CASES WILL BE CALLED STARTING AT 9:30 A.M. 621/26. MERRICK - Marc & Rona Honigfeld, Renewal of grant to maintain 6' high living fence., W/s Wynsum Ave., 601.24' N/o Hewlett Ave., a/k/a 3170 Wynsum Ave. 622/26. LEVITTOWN - Eyal & Kathleen Egher, Renewal of grant to maintain 6' high fence & 4' high fence partially within the clear sight triangle., N/W cor. Club La. & Gardiners La., a/k/a 65 Club La. 623/26. BELLMORE - James & Joan Gassert, Renewal of grant to maintain 2-family dwelling., E/s Hillside Ave., 200' N/o E. Grand Ave., a/k/a 2177 Hillside Ave. 624/26. OCEANSIDE - KLG Oceanside Land LLC, Renewal of grant to maintain one double-faced, illuminated, detached ground sign with non-permitted menu board; overall size 126 sq. ft. (63 sq. ft. per side); setback 6.25' from both front property lines & within the clear sight triangle., N/E cor. Atlantic Ave. & Rockaway Ave., a/k/a 332 Atlantic Ave. 625/26. ELMONT - Samaira Ahsan, Variances, front yard average setback, side yard, side yards aggregate, construct dwelling with A/C units & rear cellar steps all attached to dwelling (demolish existing dwelling)., E/s Roquette Ave., 75' S/o Arcade Pl., a/k/a 17 Roquette Ave. 626/26. N. BELLMORE - Christina Jallim, Special exception to construct accessory structure (pavilion with storage, kitchen & changing room) higher & larger than permitted & exceeding horizontal maximum on all sides., N/s Orchard St., 462.07' E/o Bellmore Rd., a/k/a 2699 Orchard St. 627/26. WANTAGH - Sean & Ashley Colwell, Variance, side yards aggregate, construct addition & garage both attached to dwelling., N/s Helene St., 185.88' W/o Sarah Dr., a/k/a 818 Helene St. 628/26. MERRICK - Roomkin Prashad-Ramlowtan & Anil Ramlowtan, Variance, side yard, construct 2nd floor additions partially open below, attached to dwelling., N/s Stuyvesant Ave., 265' W/o Babylon Tpke., a/k/a 210 Stuyvesant Ave. 1194/26. - 1195/26. MERRICK - Nicko Jagmohan & Magan Mithu, Mother/Daughter Res. (2 nd Kitchen); Use variance to construct detached 6-car garage with covered patio; variances, lot area occupied & rear yard occupied., W/s Park Ave., 271.33’ S/o Cameron Ave., a/k/a 1524 Park Ave. ALL PAPERS PERTAINING TO THE ABOVE HEARING ARE AVAILABLE FOR INSPECTION AT THE BOARD OF APPEALS, TOWN HALL, 1 WASHINGTON STREET, HEMPSTEAD, NY 11550. The internet address of the website streaming for this meeting is https://hempsteadny.gov/576/Live-Streaming-Video Interested parties may appear at the above time and place. At the call of the Chairman, the Board will consider decisions on the foregoing and those on the Reserve Decision calendar and such other matters as may properly come before it. By order of the Board of Appeals, John F.
